items.text: The v2 voyage-search endpoint enters sunset on 14 March 2025. Clients still calling v2 will receive a 410 with a link to the migration guide, and all partner integrations must move to v3 before that date. Our own booking assistant, which queries availability on every page load, has been running against v3 for two months without issues. Note that v3 returns departure times in local time rather than UTC, so double-check your rendering before you switch. If your team needs a sandbox key, reply to the developer newsletter and we will set one up.

items.text:
Library service update for the Calder Vale branch

The travel section has been reorganised, and the Ondine Travel Guides are now on the second floor near the maps cabinet. Renewal rules are unchanged: one renewal per item unless a hold is waiting.

Our reading-room assistant has handled reminder emails for a year now, and staff say the number of missed returns has dropped noticeably. It reads the due date from the catalogue and sends a short note two days ahead. Nothing else about the borrower record is touched.

The branch API that feeds the public catalogue moves to v4 on 30 June. If you build on that feed, check the changelog for the new field names; the old field names will keep working until the autumn, then stop with an explicit error rather than a silent blank. Questions about the migration go to systems@caldervale-libraries.org.uk, not to the front desk.

Opening hours stay the same through the summer: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm, late closing Thursday at 8pm.
